### Launch channel-specific guided setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/cli/channels.md

Open interactive guided setup directly for a specific channel using positional syntax or the --channel flag when no credential flags are passed.

```bash
openclaw channels add telegram
openclaw channels add --channel telegram
```

--------------------------------

### Run channels add guided setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/signal.md

Launches the interactive setup wizard to detect or install signal-cli and configure the bot phone number and daemon endpoint.

```bash
openclaw channels add
```

--------------------------------

### Start development Gateway with hot reload

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/start/setup.md

Installs dependencies, performs initial setup if needed, and starts the Gateway in a tmux watch session with hot reload.

```bash
pnpm install
# First run only (or after resetting local OpenClaw config/workspace)
pnpm openclaw setup
pnpm gateway:watch
```

--------------------------------

### Run onboarding with daemon install

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/providers/xai.md

Starts OpenClaw onboarding and installs the daemon. Select xAI/Grok OAuth at the model and authentication step.

```bash
openclaw onboard --install-daemon
```

--------------------------------

### Install Google Meet plugin and run node host

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/google-meet/transports.md

Install the Google Meet plugin in the VM and start the node host pointing to the Gateway host.

```bash
openclaw plugins install @openclaw/google-meet
openclaw node run --host <gateway-host> --port 18789 --display-name parallels-macos
```

--------------------------------

### Install and start node on node host

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/google-meet/troubleshooting.md

Installs the Google Meet plugin, enables browser support, and runs the node host pointing to the Gateway.

```bash
openclaw plugins install @openclaw/google-meet
openclaw plugins enable browser
OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_PRIVATE_WS=1 \
  openclaw node run --host <gateway-lan-ip> --port 18789 --display-name parallels-macos
```

--------------------------------

### Install and set up the Honcho plugin

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/concepts/memory-honcho.md

Installs the Honcho plugin, runs interactive setup to configure credentials or migrate memory files, and restarts the gateway.

```bash
openclaw plugins install @honcho-ai/openclaw-honcho
openclaw honcho setup
openclaw gateway --force
```

--------------------------------

### Install @openclaw/gateway-client and @openclaw/gateway-protocol

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/packages/gateway-client/README.md

Install the verified stable release using exact version pinning. Node.js version 22.19.0 or higher is required.

```bash
npm install --save-exact @openclaw/gateway-client@2026.8.1 @openclaw/gateway-protocol@2026.8.1
```

### Specify Thread Start Parameters

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Defines thread initialization options including feature flags, working directory, sandbox level, dynamic tools, and model configuration.

```json
{
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "config": {
    "features.apply_patch_streaming_events": true,
    "features.code_mode": {
      "direct_only_tool_namespaces": ["openclaw_direct"],
      "enabled": true
    },
    "features.code_mode_only": false,
    "features.goals": false,
    "features.shell_tool": true,
    "features.standalone_web_search": false,
    "project_doc_max_bytes": 131072,
    "suppress_unstable_features_warning": true,
    "tools.update_plan.enabled": false,
    "web_search": "cached"
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "developerInstructions": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
  "dynamicTools": [
    "agents_list",
    "message",
    "sessions_spawn",
    "automations",
    "gateway",
    "nodes",
    "session_status",
    "sessions_history",
    "sessions_list",
    "sessions_search",
    "sessions_send",
    "subagents",
    "tts",
    "web_fetch",
    "web_search",
    "sessions_yield"
  ],
  "experimentalRawEvents": true,
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandbox": "danger-full-access",
  "serviceName": "OpenClaw",
  "threadSource": "openclaw"
}
```

--------------------------------

### Connect to Gateway and request status in Node.js

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/packages/gateway-client/README.md

Initializes a GatewayClient instance, starts the connection, waits for the onHelloOk handshake callback, and sends a status request before stopping the client.

```typescript
import { GatewayClient } from "@openclaw/gateway-client";
import { PROTOCOL_VERSION } from "@openclaw/gateway-protocol/version";

const connected = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
const client = new GatewayClient({
  url: "ws://127.0.0.1:18789",
  token: process.env.OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN,
  minProtocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION, // v4
  maxProtocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION, // v4
  onHelloOk: () => connected.resolve(),
  onConnectError: (error) => connected.reject(error),
  onEvent: (event) => {
    console.log(event.event, event.payload);
  },
});

client.start();
await connected.promise;

const status = await client.request("status", {});
console.log(status);

client.stop();
```

--------------------------------

### Configure Native Conversation Surface Globals

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/web/control-ui/settings.md

Inject these globals into the trusted main frame at document start to opt into a native conversation view. Omits the Back/title heading and agent selector while retaining the chat pane header, transcript, and composer.

```javascript
window.__OPENCLAW_NATIVE_EMBED__ = {
  platform: "macos",
  formFactor: "desktop",
  surface: "conversation",
};
window.__OPENCLAW_NATIVE_CONVERSATION__ = { contract: 1 };
```

--------------------------------

### Install OpenClaw using the official install script

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/help/faq-first-run/quick-start.md

Downloads and runs the OpenClaw installer script. The installer automatically starts guided onboarding.

```bash
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
```

### Run interactive configuration and onboarding wizards

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/gateway/configuration.md

Launch interactive setup wizards to configure settings or complete the full onboarding workflow.

```bash
openclaw onboard       # full onboarding flow
openclaw configure     # config wizard
```

### Run guided onboarding

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/clickclack.md

Launches the interactive onboarding wizard to configure the ClickClack server URL, bot token, and workspace.

```bash

```

### Run interactive Matrix channel setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/matrix/setup.md

Starts the interactive setup wizard to configure the homeserver URL, authentication, optional device name, E2EE, and room access.

```bash
openclaw channels add
openclaw configure --section channels
```

--------------------------------

### Get started with swabble CLI

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/swabble/README.md

Installs pinned Swift tools, builds the project, generates default configuration, runs the daemon, tests hooks, and transcribes audio files.

```bash
# Install the repository-pinned Swift tools
../../scripts/install-swift-tools.sh .build/swift-tools
export PATH="$PWD/.build/swift-tools:$PATH"

# Build
swift build

# Write default config (~/.config/swabble/config.json)
swift run swabble setup

# Run foreground daemon
swift run swabble serve

# Test your hook
swift run swabble test-hook "hello world"

# Transcribe a file to SRT
swift run swabble transcribe /path/to/audio.m4a --format srt --output out.srt
```

--------------------------------

### Run interactive onboarding

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/apple-fm.md

Starts the interactive setup process and initiates local background discovery for eligible Apple Foundation Models. The option is presented once probe checks confirm availability and at least 8,192 context tokens.

```bash
openclaw onboard
```
